title: Ball Reversal Race
description: Four perimeter players reverse the ball from one corner to the other as fast as possible, with catch-ready feet; teams race the clock or each other.

content.objective: Swing the ball side to side with sharp, accurate passes and good spacing, as a team does against a shifting defense.
content.setup: Players in the left corner, left wing, right wing and right corner.
content.organization: One group works, another counts; switch after each race.
instructions: The left corner starts with the ball.
Pass along the arc to the right corner, then back to the left: that is one reversal.
Each receiver must catch with feet set, ready to shoot.
A dropped or loose pass resets the count to zero.
coachingPoints: Catch with feet set and turn the shoulders to the next receiver early.
Pass to the outside shoulder of the receiver.
Spacing: about five metres between players.
commonMistakes: Drifting together and shortening the passes.
Holding the ball after the catch.
content.safety: Players stay outside the arc; passes chest or overhead only.
progressions: Add two defenders who try to deflect.
Skip pass required on every second reversal.
regressions: No time limit: focus on clean catches.
successCriteria: At least four reversals in 30 seconds without a drop.
Every catch made with feet set.
content.gameApplication: Reversing the ball quickly makes a zone or help defense shift, which opens the weak side.
